card.title: Competing Theories
card.instruction: Create several explanations for what is happening. Test each new clue against them, and switch allegiance whenever one theory gains strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The hall lights failed: weather, wiring, or the caretaker saving electricity. Wiring's my favourite.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He unplugged them. Help me reach the socket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Economy takes the lead. I'll hold your ladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The socket's wet. There's rain coming through the roof.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Weather overtakes him. Leave the plug; let's ask whether he unplugged it before the leak.

mechanism: A treats the failed lights as a contest among weather, wiring and economy, changing the leading account with each physical fact.
confusable: Unlike generic investigation, the named rival explanations remain visible and A updates which leads as clues arrive.
comparison: This alternative stops a proposed electrical task after rain evidence; the cake alternative redirects a search among theft, accident and dog involvement.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
